instruction.name: xvhsubw.h.b
instruction.description: Subtract even-positioned signed 8-bit elements in `b` from odd-positioned signed 8-bit elements in `a`, sign-extending both to 16-bit, to get the 16-bit result.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500.
